get.description:
> 🔑
>
> Required OAuth scope: `users:read`.

Retrieves the profile details of the authenticated user. This user-authorized endpoint can only be used with a token issued for a specific user. Refer to the [Create an access token](doc:authentication#step-1-create-an-access-token) documentation for more information.

200.description: Returns the profile details of the user.

401.description: The given access token is either missing, invalid, has expired, or has been revoked.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content.

oneOf.description: The given access token does not have the required OAuth scope to execute the request.
oneOf.title: Invalid Scope

message.example: A human-readable message to help with debugging.

oneOf.description: Authenticated user does not have rights to perform the requested operation.
oneOf.title: User Not Authorized

message.example: A human-readable message to help with debugging.

429.description: The client has sent too many requests in a short amount of time.

oauth2.description:
Use the token from the authentication endpoint in the Authorization header.

Example: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

_id.description: The unique ID of the user.

mail.description: The email address of the user.

username.description: The username that can be used to log in if the company allows it.

lang.description: The default language of the user, in a bigram format (en, fr, de, etc.).

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

job.description: The role title of the user.

organization.description: The organization that the user belongs to.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

custom.description: The value of the **Additional information** field in the user’s profile. This is not the value of the custom fields associated with the user.

deletedAt.description: The list of dates and times when the user’s profile was soft deleted, in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ` format (ISO 8601 in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)).

primaryGroupId.description: The unique ID of the primary group of the user.

reactivatedAt.description: The list of dates and times when the user’s profile was reactivated, in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ` format (ISO 8601 in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)).

lastLoginDate.description: The date and time when the user last logged in, in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ` format (ISO 8601 in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)).

toBeDeactivatedAt.description: The date and time when the user will be deactivated, in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ` format (ISO 8601 in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)).

profileImageId.description: The unique ID of the profile image of the user.
